_meta.description: NPC library landing arrangement (drawers + curated shelves) — UI PRESENTATION config, extracted verbatim from npc-library/taxonomy.json landing_layout at world-links-3 (D-WL6: layout is not vocabulary). App-owned; edit by hand.

_note: Single interleaved list of drawer + shelf entries for the NPC Library landing. Each entry has display_order, kind ('drawer'|'shelf'), and a flavor line in Reference Voice. Drawers point at a tree node; shelves carry a membership rule. No tier gate — all tiers combined; tier filtering happens on the NPC list screen via pill filters.

entries.flavor: Centralized galactic government operating through overlapping military, intelligence, and political branches. Regional governors maintain territorial control. Stormtrooper legions serve as primary enforcement.

Military and political resistance organization. Alliance Civil Government and Alliance Military operate under joint command. Cell-structured for operational security. Resources drawn from sympathetic systems.
Decentralized network of syndicates, guilds, and independent operators spanning the Outer and Mid Rim. Loyalties are contractual. Power structures shift with trade routes and enforcement pressure.
Force-sensitive individuals and organizations operating outside both Jedi and Sith orthodoxy. Includes Imperial-era Jedi survivors, independent adepts, and pre-Republic mystic traditions.
Clone Wars-era central government and its military apparatus. Grand Army of the Republic composed of clone units under Jedi command. Senate maintained legislative authority throughout the conflict.

Confederacy of Independent Systems. Corporate-backed military coalition fielding droid armies at industrial scale. Trade Federation, Techno Union, and Commerce Guild provided primary funding and manufacturing.
Warrior culture organized into independent clans. No central government since the fall of Sundari. Clan allegiances determine operational alignment. Combat training begins in childhood.
Criminal and military coalition assembled under Maul. Incorporated Death Watch, Black Sun, Pyke Syndicate, and Nightbrother forces. Centralized around a single command authority.
Force-wielding matriarchal clans native to Dathomir. Nightsister covens practice magick distinct from both Jedi and Sith traditions. Territorial. Operate primarily on and around Dathomir.

Planetary governments, sector law enforcement, and corporate security forces. Jurisdiction is local. Authority structures vary by system. Includes CorSec, SoroSuub, Corporate Sector Authority, and independent movements.
Pre-Clone Wars era. Republic expansion period. Threats include Nihil raider fleets and emergent dark-side entities predating the Sith resurgence.
Post-Endor period. The First Order rebuilt Imperial military capacity from the Unknown Regions. The Resistance operates as an unsanctioned paramilitary opposing First Order expansion.
Non-combatant galactic population. Includes senators, diplomats, bureaucrats, merchants, workers, entertainers, and independent professionals. No factional military allegiance.
Indigenous sentient species encountered on their home territories. Includes Tuskens, Jawas, Ewoks, Felucians, Talz, Geonosians, and others. Social structures and threat posture vary by species.
Non-sentient fauna across surveyed systems. Ranges from domesticated mounts to apex predators. Threat level determined by species, territory, and provocation.
Unaffiliated mechanical units. Protocol, astromech, labor, medical, combat, and specialty models. Capabilities determined by manufacturer series and modification history.
